t: You're in Bernie Spain Gardens, a small park on the South Bank, the entertainment and commercial stretch along the south side of the River Thames. The gardens are named after Bernie Spain, who died in 1984. He was a British psychologist and a community-centred activist, and his name here honours that work for the local community. I don't have more detail about what he did or how the gardens came to carry his name, but it's a good spot to pause by the river before moving on.
